verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; cost per lead is up and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 109 leads at $7.24 per lead, but the most recent 7 days saw a 34% drop in leads with spend nearly flat — meaning efficiency fell, not budget. Two things are driving this: your Google Business Profile went completely dark for 8 consecutive days (September 1–8), removing the organic pressure that had been supporting lead flow, and the retargeting campaign that carries roughly half your Meta spend is showing signs of audience fatigue. We're refreshing the retargeting audience and restoring Google Business Profile activity this week. You should expect cost per lead to stabilize as those actions take effect, and we'll be watching the daily lead rate closely for any confirmed recovery signal.
